description: This file defines an interface and functions for translating between in-tree and CSI volume representations in Kubernetes, including topology and label management.

classes.name: InTreePlugin
classes.description: Interface for translating between in-tree and CSI volume sources in Kubernetes.

methods.name: replaceTopology
methods.description: Replaces an existing topology key in a PersistentVolume's NodeAffinity with a new key.

methods.name: getTopologyValues
methods.description: Retrieves all unique topology values for a given key from a PV's NodeAffinity, sorted alphabetically.

methods.name: addTopology
methods.description: Appends topology zones to a PV's NodeAffinity based on provided zones.

methods.name: translateTopologyFromInTreeToCSI
methods.description: Converts in-tree topology labels and zone labels to CSI topology labels in a PV.

methods.name: getTopologyLabel
methods.description: Determines whether the PV uses GA or Beta topology labels and returns the appropriate zone and region labels.

methods.name: TopologyKeyExist
methods.description: Checks if a specific topology key exists within a PV's NodeAffinity.

methods.name: translateTopologyFromCSIToInTree
methods.description: Converts CSI topology labels to in-tree Kubernetes topology labels and updates PV labels accordingly.

methods.name: regionTopologyHandler
methods.description: Adds region topology labels and NodeAffinity requirements to a PV based on a region parser function.

methods.name: translateAllowedTopologies
methods.description: Translates legacy failure domain topologies to CSI topology key expressions within storage classes or PVs.
